text.description_html:
PDQ 6-GP-03 Rim Cylinder Pull Plate for 6200 Exit Device

This is a Night Latch Function Pull Trim with Rim Lock Cylinder (turn key to retract latch, release/remove key to engage latch) for PDQ 6200 series: For use with PDQ 6300R Rim Exit Device and PDQ 6200V Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Packaged with rim lock cylinder, pull plate, mounting hardware, instructions, and 2 keys.

Features for PDQ 6-GP-03 Rim Cylinder Pull Plate

  • Function: Night Latch - Turn key to retract door latch on exit device, release/remove key to re-engage.
  • Finish: Optional Satin Stainless Steel or Dark Bronze
  • Pull Plate Height: 27"
  • Pull Plate Width: 5"
  • Pull Projection: 1-3/16"
  • Rim Cylinder: Schlage C Keyway
  • Includes Mounting Hardware
  • Includes Trim Ring
